parsed.summary: The netlist implements the intended CF-Chef architecture: ESP32-C3 with three MAX31855 thermocouple channels, TPS2121 power mux, AP63203 3.3 V buck, TPS1H200 heater high-side switch, USB-C and barrel-jack inputs, fan tach protection, and WS2812B/status LED. Reference designators are shifted relative to the specification, but the functional connectivity and key passive values match the described design, and no deviation that would change board behavior is supported by the files.
